title: S1 primitive: RecordLake, write-then-flip protocol, contract suite, docs
description:
Build the record-lake primitive: create-only write-once records per scope/domain/kind, ordering by sequence covered by the small control state, the write-records-then-flip-head helper, memory/file/S3 implementations, docs and the bucket-policy template change. No behaviour change for callers.
Acceptance: records never mutated; orphans invisible; one all-or-nothing commit; contract specs on memory, file and S3 fake; make check passes.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Started on branch feature/record-lake-storage. Design: write-once records keyed by sequence; coverage (last + skipped) lives in the journal control state; commit_with_records writes records then flips the head.
